spans.text: The sound of a violin...
Henrietta is playing her instrument alone in the garden.
If I have to say, her playing isn't particularly exceptional. Many Dolls at Griffin can play better than her.
However, what truly moves me isn't her technique or timbre, but her innocent figure and absolute concentration.
That's a nice piece.
Signore Giuseppe!
The music stops. The girl turns around, puts down her violin, and runs toward me.
I'm back, Henrietta.
Why didn't you bring me along? It would've been safer if I'd come with you...
Sorry... You were sleeping so deeply, so...
...You don't have to apologize.
I just wanted to make myself more useful to you.
You've already done a great job.
Look, I've got Rico with me.
Rico!
You're back from the Vita.
Yes. Where is Signore Jean?
Isn't he on a mission with Section 1?
He is?
I thought I saw him just now...
It's alright, they'll all be back one of these days.
Angelica has also come to the garden. Shall we wait together?
Since you're so certain, sure.
Oh right, I just had the happiest dream ever. Do you want me to tell you about it, Henrietta?
What dream?
I dreamed that I went to school and had a part-time job like an ordinary girl. Then Signore Jean came to the restaurant where I was working...
Huh...? Is that so? That sounds really interesting.
Henrietta glances at me. I smile and gesture for her to go and have fun.
She nods happily and leads Rico into the garden by the hand.
Rico must be a very important friend of hers. Sometimes I'm a little envious of young girls for their pure friendship.
I stuff my hands into my pockets and look around.
Going by my previous experience, since Rico is back, SPAS should also have returned to this garden.
I stroll around casually, and just as I expect, I see Cano poking SPAS, who's lying in a heap underneath a tall tree.
Oh, Commander.
SPAS just came tumbling down the tree all of a sudden. Do you have any idea what's going on?
Maybe she's trying to test how well she copes with her body weight in different environments?
Say what?!
SPAS suddenly jumps back on her feet. Her neural cloud seems to have returned to normal.
Simulating the virtual space had taken up most of her computational capacity, but it doesn't seem to have caused any permanent damage.
Huh...? So I'm not in there anymore...
Everything just went dark all of a sudden and the Commander disappeared to who-knows-where. It scared the crap out of me...
How did you get out?
I'm not sure either... By the time I realized what was happening, I was already falling off this tree.
Oh dear... Poor SPAS. Would you like some dessert to soothe that wounded ego?
Th...there's dessert?!
It's over there on the snack table. Henrietta said we could enjoy anything in the garden.
If we need any help, we can also just ask them.
Alright, I'm going!
You've already become such good friends with them?
They're all such adorable children. Isn't that only natural?
Canoooooo!
Where's this snack table that you were talking about?
Just stay there! I'll come and bring you to it!
Carcano M1891 gives me a wave and runs off toward SPAS.
I exhale. We've got half of our missing Dolls back.
But I still haven't found the answers to my questions in Rico's Vita.
Who was the creator of this virtual space on Level II, and why build such a place?
Furthermore, why are our Dolls trapped in here in all sorts of bizarre manners?
What Sabrina just said also bothers me.
"Until one day, a girl came to me and gave me the power that could change everything, power that didn't belong to my lady."
A girl came to Sabrina and gave her the power to change her world.
What exactly does that mean?
Is that girl the perpetrator behind all this?
The sky is growing brighter, and another dawn has broken.
Cano rescues a piece of cake from SPAS and gives it to me as breakfast. I nibble on the strawberry cake and watch as the Cyborgs discuss their experiences around the table.
Even though I've stayed in the garden for a very long time, I'm not feeling the slightest bit of fatigue.
The gentle breeze and sunlight are ever so refreshing, not to mention I'm surrounded by cute and lively girls.
This endearing scene, combined with the unique scent of fresh grass, suddenly makes me think that it won't be so bad to stay here forever.
I smack myself in the face to chase away that ridiculous thought, then walk over to sit down on the bench on the far side of the garden. I fill Kalin in on what happened.
<Size=30>Really...? So SPAS' computational capacity wasn't just used to create a simulation; it even formed a separate persona to keep Rico company.</Size>
<Size=30>That persona told me someone handed her the authorization, which was how she managed to create the simulation.</Size>
<Size=30>I don't think a simulated persona has the ability to hack our Dolls' neural clouds either...</Size>

<Size=30>But like I said, the Cyborgs here aren't malicious. Besides, this virtual space on Level II seems to have existed for a very long time. Perhaps we'll be able to find something new if we investigate the space itself.</Size>
<Size=30>Understood, I'll make another external examination. You should also hurry up and find the rest of our missing Dolls, Commander.</Size>
<Size=30>That's exactly what I'm planning to do.</Size>
Signore Giuseppe, who are you talking to?
Hmm?
Henrietta has snuck close to me with nary a whisper. I've been using the encrypted channel so my conversation with Kalina shouldn't have been perceivable.
Is something wrong, Henrietta?
Not at all, I just want to spend time with you.
Fratello don't need a reason to be in each other's company, right?
That's true...
Signore Giuseppe, Rico just told me she had a really long dream. Was she also trapped in her Vita?
You could say that.
Then thank goodness you were there to bring her back.
It is our duty as Handlers to help our Cyborgs, even though I'm not hers.
But that's what makes you so kind.
Rico is my good friend so I don't want anything bad to happen to her.
Even if it was a good dream, it was still JUST a dream, right?
Indeed...
Speaking of which... Henrietta, someone in Rico's dream told me that a person had given her the "power to change everything".
Have you met anyone like that?
Hmm?
I've never heard of anyone like that.
Is it someone outside the Agency?
I don't know. I just find it very odd.
If you're so perplexed, then let's visit another Vita to find the truth!
Now?
Everyone is busy chatting so I doubt they'd notice if we slip away quietly.
Besides, don't you want to find the other Cyborgs?
I think we only have Claes' and Triela's Vitas left?
Claes and Triela are both amazing so I'd love to see them again soon!
You said they've been in there for a long time. How long exactly?
Let me see... Around 170,000 hours?
170... But that's ages!
Actually, I'm not sure if that's ages or not...
But I did feel a little lonely out here on my own...
That's why I was so happy to see Rico and Angelica again.
I see... In that case, I'd better get everybody back here soon.
Both for your sake and ours.
Yours?
Doesn't matter. Let's go.
